name: Tango
tagline: A voice agent for the Mac that acts on whatever is on your clipboard: caption a meme, explain code, turn a page into a CSV.
problem: Using an LLM mid-task means copying text into a chat, waiting, and pasting the answer back, which breaks focus.
solution: A native macOS app hooked into the clipboard and notifications. Low-power voice-activity and wake-word detection listen for a request; the request and clipboard content go to fast LLM providers, and the result returns to the clipboard ready to paste.
demo_moment: Team-described: copy a screenshot, say a caption, and paste a finished meme; copy a word, ask for a synonym, paste.

why_it_stood_out.claim: One of 12 finalists among 261 submissions, and winner of Graphite's engineering-team prize.
Pitched as an assistant that does what people wish their built-in voice assistant did, which anyone can repeat.
Tuned wake-word and end-of-sentence detection so responses feel instant.
A two-person team reached the finals with a narrow scope that worked end to end.

lessons: Comparing your product to a familiar assistant that disappoints people gives judges the pitch in five words.
